svg.title: Electricity demand forecasting system architecture
svg.desc: Data flows from EIA-930/PJM LMP and Open-Meteo feeds through Kafka, TimescaleDB, feature engineering with Prefect and dbt, MLflow, FastAPI, and Streamlit, all running in Docker Compose on a Mac Mini, exposed publicly via Cloudflare Tunnel.

g.text: KRaft mode · load + lmp + weather topics
